description: Inks whose writing facts (dry time, water resistance, shading, sheen, flow) need looking up: inks with no source that visitors opened first, newest first; then inks with no source and a swatch photo, the most read first; then inks last looked up more than a year ago, oldest first. Each has its brand, name, current facts, when a visitor asked (facts_requested_at), when it was last looked up (facts_checked_at), and its page on inkpalette.co. Inks with no source found in the last 30 days are left out.
name: list_inks_to_research
title: List inks to research
